WITH grouped AS (
  SELECT p.throws, COUNT(*) as record_count
  FROM player_award pa
  JOIN player p ON pa.player_id = p.player_id
  GROUP BY p.throws
),
total AS (
  SELECT SUM(record_count) as total_count FROM grouped
),
shares AS (
  SELECT grouped.throws, grouped.record_count, 
         grouped.record_count * 1.0 / total.total_count as share
  FROM grouped
  CROSS JOIN total
),
avg_share_value AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share FROM shares
),
kept AS (
  SELECT shares.throws, shares.record_count, shares.share
  FROM shares
  CROSS JOIN avg_share_value
  WHERE shares.share > avg_share_value.avg_share
)
SELECT 
  SUM(record_count) as sum_of_record_counts,
  AVG(share) as average_of_shares,
  AVG(share - (SELECT avg_share FROM avg_share_value)) as avg_difference_from_mean
FROM kept
